title: POV Tuna Melt
task: mix, assemble, and fry a tuna melt
setting: Overhead POV in a home kitchen: a wooden cutting board on a black table beside a glass prep container, with a nonstick skillet on the stovetop. On hand are a can of tuna and opener, celery, green onions, mayonnaise, hot sauce, pepper, sliced sandwich bread, cheese, butter, a chef’s knife, and a spatula.

steps.text: Open the tuna, drain it, and tip it into a prep container
steps.detail: Hands work a manual can opener on a tuna can at the board, then empty and scrape the tuna into a rectangular glass container.

steps.text: Fetch celery, dice it small, and add it to the tuna
steps.detail: Celery is pulled from the fridge, stalks are lined up and chopped into small pieces on the board, then scraped into the tuna container.
flags: fingertips extended into the blade path while dicing celery

steps.text: Chop green onions and add them to the bowl
steps.detail: A bunch of green onions is trimmed and sliced on the board, then scraped into the container with the tuna and celery.

steps.text: Spoon in mayonnaise and mix the tuna salad
steps.detail: Mayonnaise is scooped from a jar into the container and stirred through until the tuna, celery, and onion are evenly coated.

steps.text: Season with pepper and hot sauce, then mix again
steps.detail: A pepper grinder and a bottle of hot sauce are shaken over the salad and the mixture is stirred smooth, ready for assembly.

steps.text: Butter a bread slice, set it in the skillet, and top with tuna and cheese
steps.detail: One face of a bread slice is buttered and laid in the hot pan; tuna salad is spooned on and cheese slices are laid over the filling.

steps.text: Butter the top slice, close the sandwich, and fry it
steps.detail: The second slice is buttered and pressed on top; the melt is cooked in the skillet and turned with a spatula, then lifted out.

steps.text: Plate the tuna melt and cut it in half
steps.detail: The finished sandwich is carried to the table, set on a white plate, and separated into halves for serving.

afterClip: Eat the plated tuna melt while it is still hot.
